name: Unidentified Sheathipede-class transport shuttle
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified Sheathipede-class transport shuttle (Count Dooku's frigate)
description: A Sheathipede-class transport shuttle was stolen from Dooku's Munificent-class star frigate by Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker during a skirmish of the Clone Wars.
